h1: The 5 Best Lateral Filing Cabinets of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Lateral File Cabinets 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: two true lateral filing cabinets plus three compact vertical alternatives, compared on width, drawers, locks and footprint.
summary: The Letaya 2-drawer lateral cabinet is our top pick for a true lateral layout with a lock and anti-tip protection. The DEVAISE 3-drawer rolling lateral adds a third drawer. Three vertical alternatives, the Letaya 3-drawer, DEVAISE 2-drawer and VASAGLE CUSTOS, fit buyers short on floor space.
intro: Many cabinets sold as lateral are actually vertical ones with the word in the title. A lateral cabinet is wide and shallow, with drawers that pull out along the long side, and that changes both the room it needs in front and the way files sit. Checking the listed width is the fastest way to tell.

Only two of the eight listings we reviewed are genuinely lateral, so this guide ranks those two first and adds three compact vertical alternatives, clearly labeled. We ranked on spec sheets and owner reports, not on filing tests, and price is shown as a bucket.

products.name: Letaya 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Metal Lateral Filing Cabinet for Home Office
products.verdict: A true lateral cabinet with a lock and anti-tip interlock.
products.description:
The Letaya is a genuinely lateral metal cabinet, 28.35 inches wide, with two locking drawers and hanging file support for Letter, Legal and A4. An anti-tip drawer interlock stops two drawers opening at once. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It heads the list because it delivers the real lateral shape with safety and security at a low price. The DEVAISE below adds a drawer and wheels but gives up the lock mention.

It suits buyers who need true lateral filing and have front clearance. The caveat is the 28 inch width, which takes wall space.
products.idealFor: Home offices wanting real lateral filing.

products.name: DEVAISE 3-Drawer Mobile File Cabinet, Lateral Filing Cabinet, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: Three lateral drawers on wheels in a wood-look finish.
products.description:
The DEVAISE is a lateral cabinet with three drawers, rolling casters, hanging file support and a rustic brown wood-look finish. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

It ranks second because the third drawer and wheels add capacity and flexibility, but the specs mention no lock, which the Letaya offers.

It suits buyers who want to reposition the cabinet around a room. The caveat is that casters on a loaded cabinet need locking or a flat floor.

products.name: Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet with Lock, Under Desk Metal Filing Cabinets
products.verdict: More drawers than a lateral cabinet in far less width.
products.description:
This Letaya is a vertical mobile pedestal, not lateral, with three locking drawers, full assembly and an under-desk fit. It handles Letter, Legal and A4 and sits in the $50-100 bucket.

Bronze here is because it is not lateral, but it stores plenty without the width of the two above and keeps a lock.

It suits desks with limited floor space. The caveat is that the drawers are deeper than wide, so you pull out further.

products.name: DEVAISE 2 Drawer Metal File Cabinet, Fully Assembled, Under Desk, Black
products.verdict: A tidy assembled pedestal that tucks under a standard desk.
products.description:
The DEVAISE 2-drawer is a vertical pedestal, not lateral, arriving fully assembled with a lock, under-desk fit and Letter, Legal and A4 support. It falls in the $100-200 bucket.

It ranks fourth because it costs more than the Letaya 3-drawer for fewer drawers, though you skip assembly.

It suits buyers who want a simple, ready-to-use under-desk file drawer. The caveat is the higher price for two drawers.
products.idealFor: Desks needing a ready-to-use file drawer.
products.skipIf: You want the most drawers per dollar.

products.name: VASAGLE CUSTOS 2-Drawer File Cabinet, Small Rolling Filing Cabinet for Home Office
products.verdict: The narrowest option, which doubles as a printer stand.
products.description:
The VASAGLE CUSTOS is a vertical, 15.7 inch wide two-drawer rolling cabinet in matte black that also works as a printer stand. It sits in the $50-100 bucket.

Bottom of the list, owing to the fact that it is the furthest from lateral and the specs list no lock. Its argument is the smallest footprint here.

It suits tight corners where a printer also needs a home. The caveat is lighter file capacity.
products.idealFor: Tight corners needing a printer stand too.
products.skipIf: You need a lock or heavy file capacity.

whatMatters.detail: Lateral cabinets are wide with files stored side to side, while vertical ones are narrow and deep. Lateral needs wall space, vertical needs pull-out room. Check the listed width before ordering.
A lock keeps documents private and tamper-resistant. Not all cabinets include one. Look for the word lock in the listing.
An interlock lets only one drawer open at once so the cabinet cannot tip forward. It matters on tall or loaded units. Check the feature list.
Letter, Legal and A4 hanging file support decide what you can store. Legal files need extra width. Verify the sizes in the specs.
Wheels let you move the cabinet but can shift under load. Locking casters help. Read whether the listing says rolling or fixed.

faq.q: Is a lateral cabinet better than a vertical one?
faq.a: It uses wall space instead of depth and stores files side to side. It suits wide walls.
Trusting the word lateral in the title. Check the width.

faq.q: Is the DEVAISE worth it over the Letaya?
faq.a: If you need three drawers and wheels. Otherwise the Letaya has a lock and anti-tip.
The Letaya and under-desk pedestals list Legal support. Check others.

faq.q: How do I stop it tipping?
faq.a: Load heavy files low and use an interlock model.
Some arrive assembled, others need it. Read the listing.

finalTake: The Letaya 2 Drawer is the best true lateral cabinet here. The DEVAISE 3-Drawer adds capacity and wheels. If floor space is limited, the Letaya 3 Drawer and VASAGLE CUSTOS are the sensible vertical choices. Check the width first.
